meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每次回应前会先调取相关历史记忆,每轮结束后把新见解存下来。记忆写在每个 agent group 的 .claude/ 挂载里,容器重启也不丢。
howto.when: 用在运行默认 Claude provider 的 agent group 上,group 的 container.json 里 provider 缺失或为 claude 时才生效。mnemon hooks 只在 --target claude-code 下运行。

say.text: 把 mnemon 装到容器镜像里,然后重建镜像并重启服务。
say.note: 走安装、重建与重启三步流程。

say.text: 检查 mnemon hooks 有没有注册上,再测一次记忆召回。
say.note: 查 settings.json 并做跨会话召回测试。

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon into the agent container image, so it recalls relevant past context before answering and stores new insights after each turn. Memory sits in the per-agent-group .claude/ mount and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Runs on agent groups using the default Claude provider; mnemon hooks only fire under --target claude-code, and a group with a different provider (e.g. opencode) never invokes the claude CLI.

say_en.text: Install mnemon in the container image, then rebuild and restart the service.
say_en.note: Runs the install, rebuild and restart steps.

say_en.text: Check whether this agent group uses the default Claude provider.
say_en.note: Reads the provider key in each group's container.json.

say_en.text: Verify the mnemon hooks are registered and test recall across sessions.
say_en.note: Checks settings.json, then tests memory recall.
